competitor_findings.sample_scope: Public Alibaba product and showroom pages; Firecrawl was unavailable, so current public search was used manually.
patterns: Relevant cards combine product category, construction/material and one buyer-facing differentiator instead of relying on wide toe box alone.
High-credibility cards expose real color choices, size range, price tiers, MOQ and customization options above the fold.
Many competitor titles overuse barefoot, zero drop, orthopedic, diabetic, medical and tested anti-slip language; these are not transferable to BQ002 without exact evidence.
Clean single-product white-background images dominate the product card; secondary images show side, outsole, top view, pair and color range.

decision: Protect the source link. Optimize all three zero-data extensions as a coordinated family: W1 leads broad walking-style wholesale intent with Grey Black, R1 leads daily walking with Grey Khaki, and O1 leads custom-logo/OEM intent with Grey White. Wide Toe Box remains a supported differentiator, not the sole traffic term.
